MARS-01

MARTIAN NUCLEAR RESEARCH FACILITY • SMR FISSION SYSTEM

Step into humanity's first permanent nuclear fission power plant on Mars. Explore the facility exterior, inspect cutaway cross-sections of the reactor vessel, manipulate control rod assemblies, and discover how nuclear fission thermal energy converts into electricity in the harsh Martian environment.

Conceptual educational visualization. Distinguishes conceptual thermodynamic principles from real engineering safety. Operating figures are illustrative.
